author: Igor Pavlov
text: Maybe your usb was slow for data writing by some reason. What is your usb drive and speed of that usb? Try to copy some big file to that usb. Maybe you will have similar problems write more information about issue: what archive type: zip or 7z? compression settings do you create new archive ot update previous version of archive? number of original files total size of original files archive size cpu ram size windows system
